# Blora Design

> Token-driven, accessible, zero-dependency Web UI design system (2.0 alpha).

## System

Blora Design 2.0 prefers native HTML semantics, headless controllers, and a small set of Web Components. Design Tokens (DTCG JSON → CSS) drive visuals. Light/dark, RTL, and WCAG 2.2 AA are project goals. Core package has zero runtime third-party dependencies.

## Installation

```bash
pnpm add @bloret-crew/blora-design@alpha
```

```js
import "@bloret-crew/blora-design/tokens.css";
import "@bloret-crew/blora-design/foundations.css";
import { createTableController, toast, defineBloraSelect } from "@bloret-crew/blora-design";
// optional CE auto-register:
// import "@bloret-crew/blora-design/auto";
// tree-shake friendly subpaths:
// import { createTableController } from "@bloret-crew/blora-design/table";
```

Use `.blora-button[data-variant="primary"]` — not 1.x `.blora-btn--primary` / global `Blora.init()`.

## Key entry points

- Package: `@bloret-crew/blora-design` (`2.0.0-alpha.1`+)
- `./auto` — register stable custom elements (select, dialog)
- `./button` `./select` `./dialog` `./table` `./toast` — JS subpaths
- `./blora.global.js` — IIFE CDN global `Blora`
- `./compat/v1` + `./compat/v1.css` — 1.x compatibility
- `./custom-elements.json` / `./component-manifest.json` / `./api-snapshot.json`
- Human guide: `docs/guide.md`
- Contracts: `packages/blora-design/contracts/*.contract.json`
- Contract stability policy: `docs/refactor/contract-stability.md`
- Component matrix: `docs/refactor/component-matrix.md`
- **Remaining work:** `docs/refactor/remaining-work.md` (stop before Beta until checklist)
- Migration: `docs/migration/v1-to-v2.md`
- Token map CSV: `docs/migration/token-map-v1-v2.csv`
- Alpha install notes: `docs/refactor/alpha-install-notes.md`
- 1.x freeze: `legacy/v1/`, `legacy/showcase-v1.html`
- Add-ons: `@bloret-crew/blora-design-{markdown,thread,qrcode,effects,layout,theming}@alpha`

## Architecture

- Prefer native HTML; Custom Elements only for composite shipped CE (select, dialog).
- Most interactive widgets: `createXxxController(root)` + destroy on teardown.
- Table row selection: `data-blora-selectable` (built-in).
- Form-associated WC for every control is **not** the default (ADR-013).
- `sideEffects`: CSS files + `dist/auto.js` only (main entry is tree-shake friendly).

## Prohibitions

- Do not extract visual styles from historical commits or other UI frameworks.
- Do not use `innerHTML` with untrusted strings.
- Do not hardcode colors/spacing/radii/shadows/z-index in component CSS — use tokens.
- Do not add public APIs without updating the contract and regenerating manifests.
- Do not delete `legacy/v1` during 2.0.

## Migration

1.x → 2.0: `docs/migration/v1-to-v2.md`. Compat: `@bloret-crew/blora-design/compat/v1`.
